citations.case_name: Harborline Logistics, LLC v. Calloway Grain Co.
citations.quote: [A]rbitration is a matter of contract and a party cannot be required to submit to arbitration any dispute which he has not agreed so to submit. (quoting United Steelworkers v. Warrior & Gulf Navigation Co., 363 U.S. 574, 582 (1960))
